sloka: तं शैलमिव शैलाभाः सर्वे ते प्लवगर्षभाः।समारुह्य समुत्पत्य ददंशुश्च महाबलाः ।। ६.६७.३२ ।।
transliteration: taṁ śailamiva śailābhāḥ sarve te plavagarṣabhāḥ।samāruhya samutpatya dadaṁśuśca mahābalāḥ ।। 6.67.32 ।।

translations.english: Hurt by the blows of Kumbhakarna, their eyes bathed in blood, the Vanaras fainted and fell on the ground like cut down Kimsuka trees.
